references.text: The Lord saved Israel from the Egyptians, as mentioned in Judges 10:11
Israel's victory over the Amorites under Sihon, which the Lord reminds them of
Joshua summarizes the Lord's deliverance from the Egyptians, Amorites, and other enemies
The Ammonites oppressed Israel, and the Lord gave them into the hand of Eglon
Shamgar saved Israel from the Philistines
Samuel reminds the people that the Lord brought them out of Egypt
The Lord identifies Himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt
The psalm praises the Lord for striking down the Egyptians and Amorites
The Philistines oppressed Israel for forty years
